Title: [JOURNEY] Passkey — add on Security page, sign out, sign in with passkey, land in own organization
Preconditions:
Build under test: platform 3.1091.0-pr-3144, storefront theme 2.61.0-pr-2601, Passkeys module 3.1000.0-pr-1, Customer module with customer#324 - all open PRs on 2026-10-28. On a stand without them the case is BLOCKED for the build, never FAIL, and is never re-based to the older behaviour.
CEREMONY: Chromium lanes only (playwright-chrome or playwright-edge, never firefox). Before the first step a WebAuthn virtual authenticator is set up through the Chrome DevTools Protocol: WebAuthn.enable, then WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator {protocol: ctap2, transport: internal, hasResidentKey: true, hasUserVerification: true, isUserVerified: true, automaticPresenceSimulation: true}; capture authenticatorId; it is removed in Cleanup.
